== Summary ==
Identified: [[Matt Scott]] (left) and [[Barry Alperstein]] (right, grey tee). Remaining faces unlabeled.
A match at the feature table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]

* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
